# VélezReyes+ Presentation Skill

## Overview

Use this skill to build any VélezReyes+ presentation from scratch using PptxGenJS. Always follow the brand rules, color system, typography, layout patterns, and decorative system defined here. Output is a `.pptx` file that opens correctly in Google Slides and PowerPoint.

---

## Brand Identity

**VélezReyes+** is bold, direct, and visually alive. Presentations feel energetic but structured — not corporate-generic. The base is cream (`#EFEFE4`) for most content, with black and accent colors used intentionally for covers, section moments, highlights, and statements. Use color as a punctuation mark, not wallpaper.

---

## Color System

### Backgrounds

| Name | HEX | Usage |
|------|-----|-------|
| Cream | `#EFEFE4` | **Primary** — most content slides |
| Cream soft | `#F3F1E7` | Subtle variant for alternating or nested content |
| Black | `#000000` | Cover, closing, section dividers, bold statement slides |
| Near Black | `#1A1A1A` | Dark content panels, nested containers on black slides |

### Accent backgrounds (use when content demands it)

| Name | HEX | When to use as background |
|------|-----|--------------------------|
| Neon Yellow | `#F3FF00` | Full-slide highlight, banner rows, key callout blocks |
| Green | `#27CF77` | Positive result highlights, success sections |
| Purple | `#A62BFF` | Deep narrative, culture moments, contrast sections |

### Split-background pattern (from Culture Deck)
Use a half-color / half-cream or half-black layout for visual dynamism on specific slides:
- Left half black + right half cream → contrast two ideas
- Left half accent color + right half black → announcement style
- Full-width accent strip (top or bottom, 25–30% of slide height) + cream remainder

### Accent colors — all three in every deck

| Name | HEX | Text on it | Where |
|------|-----|------------|-------|
| Neon Yellow | `#F3FF00` | `#000000` | **Dark slides only** — cover bar, closing bar, stats on black, labels on black backgrounds |
| Green | `#27CF77` | `#000000` | **Cream slides** — numbers, labels, arrows, callouts, card headers |
| Purple | `#A62BFF` | `#FFFFFF` | **Cream slides** — numbers, labels, section pills, card headers, split backgrounds |

> **All three accents appear in every deck.** This is how VélezReyes+ manages its visual identity — the three colors work as a system, not as alternatives. Yellow anchors the dark moments, Green and Purple distribute across the cream content slides.

> **Critical: Yellow `#F3FF00` is invisible on cream** — never use it as text, number, or label on `#EFEFE4` backgrounds. Yellow only works on black/dark.

### Accent distribution pattern (apply to every deck)

| Slide type | Yellow | Green | Purple |
|------------|--------|-------|--------|
| Cover | Left bar + subtitle text | — | — |
| Numbered list (cream) | — | Numbers + bars | Alternating items or labels |
| Section divider (black) | Optional subtitle | — | Pill / number |
| Two-column (cream) | — | Left card label | Right card label |
| KPI (cream) | — | 1st or 2nd stat | 1st or 2nd stat |
| Full-accent slide | Yellow bg (text black) | Green bg (text black) | Purple bg (text white) |
| Split bg | Yellow left half | Green left half | Purple left half |
| Closing | — bar | — | Left bar OR Yellow bar |

Mix freely within these rules. The goal is that all three colors are visible somewhere in the deck.

### Typography colors

| Name | HEX | Usage |
|------|-----|-------|
| Black | `#000000` | Primary text on cream slides |
| White | `#FFFFFF` | Text on black/dark/purple slides |
| Cream text | `#EFEFE4` | Softer white on very dark slides |
| Dark gray | `#333333` | Body text on cream, slightly lighter than black |
| Muted | `#B0B0A8` | Captions, secondary labels, footnotes |
| Gray | `#6B7280` | Supporting text on dark slides |

## Logos — Embedded

| Version | File | Use on |
|---------|------|--------|
| Light logo (cream text) | b64 below | Black and dark slides |
| Dark logo (black text) | b64 below | Cream slides, Yellow/Green accent backgrounds |

```js
function logoData(dark) {
  // dark=true  → light logo (cream text) → black/dark slides
  // dark=false → dark logo (black text)  → cream/yellow/green slides
  const lightLogo = 'data:image/png;base64,';
  const darkLogo  = 'data:image/png;base64,';
  return dark ? lightLogo : darkLogo;
}
```

**Standard position — top right, all slides except cover and closing:**
```js
// All content slides — top right
slide.addImage({ data: logoData(isDark), x: 11.45, y: 0.22, w: 1.65, h: 0.29 });
```

**Cover position — centered above the title area:**
```js
// Cover — centered, above main title
slide.addImage({ data: logoData(true), x: 5.59, y: 0.38, w: 2.15, h: 0.38 });
```

**Closing position — centered below the main message:**
```js
// Closing — centered, below text
slide.addImage({ data: logoData(true), x: 5.59, y: 5.35, w: 2.15, h: 0.38 });
```

## Fonts — Embedded

DM Serif Display for display/titles + Montserrat for body. Base64 strings are embedded — Google Slides and PowerPoint load these natively when the fontFace names match exactly.

```js
// Font base64 reference — use fontFace: 'DM Serif Display' or 'Montserrat' in all text calls
const FONTS = {
  'DM Serif Display Regular': 'data:font/ttf;base64,',
  'DM Serif Display Italic':  'data:font/ttf;base64,',
  'Montserrat Regular':       'data:font/ttf;base64,',
  'Montserrat Bold':          'data:font/ttf;base64,',
  'Montserrat SemiBold':      'data:font/ttf;base64,',
  'Montserrat Italic':        'data:font/ttf;base64,',
  'Montserrat Light':         'data:font/ttf;base64,',
};
// Always declare fontFace exactly as 'DM Serif Display' or 'Montserrat'
```

### Font usage

| Element | Font | Size | Weight | Color context |
|---------|------|------|--------|---------------|
| Cover main title | DM Serif Display | 52–68pt | Regular | White on black |
| Cover subtitle accent | DM Serif Display | 28–36pt | Regular | Accent color |
| Section / divider title | DM Serif Display | 44–56pt | Regular | White or accent |
| Slide title (content) | Montserrat | 26–32pt | Bold | Black on cream |
| Large statement quote | DM Serif Display | 32–42pt | Italic | Black or accent |
| Large stat number | DM Serif Display | 60–80pt | Regular | Accent or black |
| Numbered item number | DM Serif Display | 32–36pt | Regular | Accent color |
| Body paragraph | Montserrat | 13–15pt | Regular | #333333 on cream |
| Label / eyebrow | Montserrat | 9–11pt | SemiBold | Accent or muted |
| Caption / footnote | Montserrat | 10–11pt | Regular | #B0B0A8 |

## Slide Dimensions

```js
pptx.layout = 'LAYOUT_WIDE'; // 13.33 × 7.5 inches
```

---

## Decorative System

### All lines are dotted — always
Every structural line (separators, dividers between columns, conceptual map connectors, card borders) must use `dashType: 'dot'`. Only exception: the left accent bar on covers/closing (structural, full-height solid block).

```js
// Standard dotted line — horizontal separator
function dotLine(slide, x, y, w, color) {
  color = color || '999990';
  slide.addShape(pptx.ShapeType.line, {
    x: x, y: y, w: w, h: 0,
    line: { color: color, width: 0.6, dashType: 'dot' }
  });
}

// Dotted vertical divider (between columns, KPI cells)
function dotLineV(slide, x, y, h, color) {
  color = color || '999990';
  slide.addShape(pptx.ShapeType.line, {
    x: x, y: y, w: 0, h: h,
    line: { color: color, width: 0.6, dashType: 'dot' }
  });
}

// Dotted border rectangle (cards, containers)
function dotRect(slide, x, y, w, h, fillColor, borderColor) {
  slide.addShape(pptx.ShapeType.roundRect, {
    x: x, y: y, w: w, h: h,
    fill: { color: fillColor || 'F3F1E7' },
    line: { color: borderColor || '999990', width: 0.6, dashType: 'dot' },
    rectRadius: 0.06
  });
}
```

### Left accent bar (cover and closing only — solid, structural)
```js
function accentBar(slide, color) {
  slide.addShape(pptx.ShapeType.rect, {
    x: 0, y: 0, w: 0.12, h: 7.5,
    fill: { color: color }, line: { type: 'none' }
  });
}
```

### Header bar (content slides — thin dark strip with title)
```js
function headerBar(slide, title, sectionLabel, isDark) {
  var bgColor = isDark ? '0A0A0A' : '000000';
  var logoDark = true; // logo always light version in header bar
  slide.addShape(pptx.ShapeType.rect, {
    x: 0, y: 0, w: 13.33, h: 0.82,
    fill: { color: bgColor }, line: { type: 'none' }
  });
  slide.addText(title, {
    x: 0.42, y: 0.08, w: 9.2, h: 0.64,
    fontFace: 'Montserrat', fontSize: 26, bold: true,
    color: 'FFFFFF', valign: 'middle'
  });
  if (sectionLabel) {
    slide.addText(sectionLabel, {
      x: 6.5, y: 0.16, w: 4.6, h: 0.5,
      fontFace: 'Montserrat', fontSize: 12,
      color: '6B7280', align: 'right', valign: 'middle'
    });
  }
  // Dotted separator below header
  dotLine(slide, 0, 0.83, 13.33, '333333');
  // Logo top right
  slide.addImage({ data: logoData(logoDark), x: 11.45, y: 0.2, w: 1.65, h: 0.29 });
}
```

## Background & Color Distribution Rules

1. **Cream is the primary background** for most content slides — use `#EFEFE4`
2. **Black for impact moments** — cover, closing, section dividers, strong statements
3. **Accent colors as background sparingly** — max 1–2 slides per deck as full accent bg; use for highlights, success callouts, or culture moments
4. **Split-bg pattern** — valid option for slides introducing a contrast (left black + right cream, or top accent strip + cream body)
5. **On cream slides** — use accent colors on text titles, labels, callouts, and numbers — not on body copy
6. **Never all-black deck** — if most slides are dark, add cream relief slides; the deck should breathe

## Slide Templates

### Cover Slide
Black bg, left accent bar, logo centered top, eyebrow, big DM Serif title, accent subtitle, italic tagline. No asset placeholder shown — space is left open for manual asset placement.

```js
function addCover(slide, accentColor, eyebrow, title, subtitle, tagline) {
  slide.background = { color: '000000' };
  accentBar(slide, accentColor);

  // Logo — centered, above title area
  slide.addImage({ data: logoData(true), x: 5.59, y: 0.38, w: 2.15, h: 0.38 });

  // Eyebrow
  if (eyebrow) slide.addText(eyebrow, {
    x: 0.28, y: 1.1, w: 10.5, h: 0.35,
    fontFace: 'Montserrat', fontSize: 11, bold: true,
    color: 'B0B0A8', charSpacing: 2
  });

  // Main title
  slide.addText(title, {
    x: 0.28, y: 1.5, w: 10.0, h: 2.8,
    fontFace: 'DM Serif Display', fontSize: 64,
    color: 'FFFFFF', lineSpacingMultiple: 1.1
  });

  // Accent subtitle
  if (subtitle) slide.addText(subtitle, {
    x: 0.28, y: 4.3, w: 9.5, h: 0.72,
    fontFace: 'DM Serif Display', fontSize: 32,
    color: accentColor
  });

  // Italic tagline
  if (tagline) slide.addText(tagline, {
    x: 0.28, y: 5.1, w: 9.5, h: 0.4,
    fontFace: 'DM Serif Display', fontSize: 17,
    color: 'B0B0A8', italic: true
  });
  // Right area (top-right) is left open for manual asset placement
}
```

### Section Divider
```js
function addSection(slide, num, title, accentColor) {
  slide.background = { color: '000000' };

  // Accent pill
  slide.addShape(pptx.ShapeType.roundRect, {
    x: 0.5, y: 1.8, w: 0.9, h: 0.52,
    fill: { color: accentColor }, line: { type: 'none' }, rectRadius: 0.26
  });
  slide.addText(num, {
    x: 0.5, y: 1.8, w: 0.9, h: 0.52,
    fontFace: 'Montserrat', fontSize: 14, bold: true,
    color: accentColor === 'A62BFF' ? 'FFFFFF' : '000000',
    align: 'center', valign: 'middle'
  });

  slide.addText(title, {
    x: 0.5, y: 2.45, w: 11.5, h: 2.8,
    fontFace: 'DM Serif Display', fontSize: 52,
    color: 'FFFFFF', lineSpacingMultiple: 1.1
  });

  slide.addImage({ data: logoData(true), x: 11.45, y: 0.2, w: 1.65, h: 0.29 });
  // Right area left open for manual asset placement
}
```

### Content Slide — Cream (default)
```js
function addContent(slide, title, sectionLabel, body, accentColor) {
  slide.background = { color: 'EFEFE4' };
  headerBar(slide, title, sectionLabel, false);

  slide.addText(body, {
    x: 0.45, y: 1.05, w: 12.43, h: 5.85,
    fontFace: 'Montserrat', fontSize: 14,
    color: '333333', valign: 'top', lineSpacingMultiple: 1.4
  });
}
```

### Numbered List Slide — Cream
Numbers in DM Serif, accent color, single-line "01" format. Bar + number + title inline.

```js
function addNumberedList(slide, title, items, accentColor) {
  slide.background = { color: 'EFEFE4' };
  headerBar(slide, title, null, false);

  var gap = (5.9) / Math.min(items.length, 5);
  items.forEach(function(item, i) {
    var y = 1.05 + i * gap;
    // Left accent bar segment
    slide.addShape(pptx.ShapeType.rect, {
      x: 0.42, y: y + 0.08, w: 0.05, h: gap * 0.72,
      fill: { color: accentColor }, line: { type: 'none' }
    });
    // Number — single text box, no line breaks, wide enough for "05"
    slide.addText(item.num || String(i+1).padStart(2,'0'), {
      x: 0.58, y: y, w: 0.82, h: gap * 0.9,
      fontFace: 'DM Serif Display', fontSize: 34,
      color: accentColor, valign: 'middle', align: 'left'
    });
    // Title bold
    slide.addText(item.title, {
      x: 1.48, y: y + 0.1, w: 11.1, h: gap * 0.45,
      fontFace: 'Montserrat', fontSize: 14, bold: true,
      color: '000000', valign: 'middle'
    });
    // Body
    if (item.body) slide.addText(item.body, {
      x: 1.48, y: y + 0.46, w: 11.1, h: gap * 0.45,
      fontFace: 'Montserrat', fontSize: 12,
      color: '6B7280', valign: 'top'
    });
    // Dotted separator between items (not after last)
    if (i < items.length - 1) {
      dotLine(slide, 0.42, y + gap - 0.05, 12.43, 'CCCCCC');
    }
  });
}
```

### Two-Column Slide — Cream
```js
function addTwoCol(slide, title, sectionLabel, left, right, accentColor) {
  // left/right = { label, title, body }
  slide.background = { color: 'EFEFE4' };
  headerBar(slide, title, sectionLabel, false);

  // Optional quote/intro box at top
  if (left.intro) {
    dotRect(slide, 0.45, 1.05, 12.43, 1.05, 'E8E8DC', 'BBBBAA');
    slide.addText(left.intro, {
      x: 0.65, y: 1.1, w: 12.03, h: 0.9,
      fontFace: 'DM Serif Display', fontSize: 18, italic: true,
      color: '333333', align: 'center', valign: 'middle'
    });
  }

  var colY = left.intro ? 2.3 : 1.08;
  var colH = left.intro ? 4.9 : 6.1;

  // Left card
  dotRect(slide, 0.42, colY, 6.12, colH, 'F3F1E7', 'CCCCCC');
  if (left.label) slide.addText(left.label.toUpperCase(), {
    x: 0.62, y: colY + 0.15, w: 5.72, h: 0.32,
    fontFace: 'Montserrat', fontSize: 10, bold: true,
    color: accentColor === 'A62BFF' ? accentColor : accentColor,
    charSpacing: 1.5, align: 'center'
  });
  if (left.title) slide.addText(left.title, {
    x: 0.62, y: colY + 0.52, w: 5.72, h: 0.7,
    fontFace: 'DM Serif Display', fontSize: 28,
    color: '000000', align: 'center'
  });
  dotLine(slide, 0.62, colY + 1.3, 5.72, 'CCCCCC');
  if (left.body) slide.addText(left.body, {
    x: 0.62, y: colY + 1.45, w: 5.72, h: colH - 1.65,
    fontFace: 'Montserrat', fontSize: 13,
    color: '333333', valign: 'top', lineSpacingMultiple: 1.4
  });

  // Dotted vertical divider between columns
  dotLineV(slide, 6.66, colY + 0.15, colH - 0.3, 'CCCCCC');

  // Right card
  dotRect(slide, 6.79, colY, 6.12, colH, 'F3F1E7', 'CCCCCC');
  if (right.label) slide.addText(right.label.toUpperCase(), {
    x: 6.99, y: colY + 0.15, w: 5.72, h: 0.32,
    fontFace: 'Montserrat', fontSize: 10, bold: true,
    color: right.accentColor || '27CF77',
    charSpacing: 1.5, align: 'center'
  });
  if (right.title) slide.addText(right.title, {
    x: 6.99, y: colY + 0.52, w: 5.72, h: 0.7,
    fontFace: 'DM Serif Display', fontSize: 28,
    color: '000000', align: 'center'
  });
  dotLine(slide, 6.99, colY + 1.3, 5.72, 'CCCCCC');
  if (right.body) slide.addText(right.body, {
    x: 6.99, y: colY + 1.45, w: 5.72, h: colH - 1.65,
    fontFace: 'Montserrat', fontSize: 13,
    color: '333333', valign: 'top', lineSpacingMultiple: 1.4
  });
}
```

### KPI / Data Slide — Cream
```js
function addKPI(slide, title, kpis, accentColor) {
  slide.background = { color: 'EFEFE4' };
  headerBar(slide, title, null, false);

  var cols   = Math.min(kpis.length, 4);
  var cellW  = 12.43 / cols;

  kpis.forEach(function(k, i) {
    var cx  = 0.45 + i * cellW + 0.15;
    var cw  = cellW - 0.3;
    var kColor = i === 0 ? accentColor : '000000';
    slide.addText(k.value, {
      x: cx, y: 1.7, w: cw, h: 2.2,
      fontFace: 'DM Serif Display', fontSize: 72,
      color: kColor, align: 'center'
    });
    slide.addText(k.label.toUpperCase(), {
      x: cx, y: 3.98, w: cw, h: 0.32,
      fontFace: 'Montserrat', fontSize: 9, bold: true,
      color: '999990', align: 'center', charSpacing: 1
    });
    if (k.sublabel) slide.addText(k.sublabel, {
      x: cx, y: 4.32, w: cw, h: 0.3,
      fontFace: 'Montserrat', fontSize: 10,
      color: 'B0B0A8', align: 'center'
    });
    // Dotted vertical divider between cells
    if (i < cols - 1) {
      dotLineV(slide, 0.45 + (i+1)*cellW, 1.5, 3.4, 'CCCCCC');
    }
  });
}
```

### Statement / Quote Slide — Accent background
Full-slide or split-bg for strong narrative moments.

```js
function addStatement(slide, statement, attribution, accentColor, mode) {
  // mode: 'full' (full accent bg) | 'split-left' (left half accent, right cream)
  // | 'top-strip' (top 35% accent, bottom cream)

  if (mode === 'full') {
    slide.background = { color: accentColor };
    var textColor = accentColor === 'A62BFF' ? 'FFFFFF' : '000000';
    slide.addText(statement, {
      x: 1.0, y: 1.8, w: 11.33, h: 3.5,
      fontFace: 'DM Serif Display', fontSize: 44, italic: true,
      color: textColor, align: 'center', lineSpacingMultiple: 1.2
    });
    if (attribution) slide.addText(attribution, {
      x: 1.0, y: 5.5, w: 11.33, h: 0.4,
      fontFace: 'Montserrat', fontSize: 11, bold: true,
      color: textColor, align: 'center', charSpacing: 1.5
    });
    slide.addImage({ data: logoData(accentColor === 'A62BFF'), x: 5.59, y: 6.55, w: 2.15, h: 0.38 });

  } else if (mode === 'split-left') {
    // Left half accent, right half cream
    slide.background = { color: 'EFEFE4' };
    slide.addShape(pptx.ShapeType.rect, {
      x: 0, y: 0, w: 6.66, h: 7.5,
      fill: { color: accentColor }, line: { type: 'none' }
    });
    var leftTC = accentColor === 'A62BFF' ? 'FFFFFF' : '000000';
    slide.addText(statement, {
      x: 0.45, y: 1.5, w: 5.76, h: 4.5,
      fontFace: 'DM Serif Display', fontSize: 36, italic: true,
      color: leftTC, lineSpacingMultiple: 1.25
    });
    if (attribution) slide.addText(attribution, {
      x: 7.1, y: 1.5, w: 5.78, h: 4.5,
      fontFace: 'Montserrat', fontSize: 14,
      color: '333333', lineSpacingMultiple: 1.5
    });
    slide.addImage({ data: logoData(true), x: 11.45, y: 0.2, w: 1.65, h: 0.29 });

  } else { // top-strip
    slide.background = { color: 'EFEFE4' };
    slide.addShape(pptx.ShapeType.rect, {
      x: 0, y: 0, w: 13.33, h: 2.6,
      fill: { color: accentColor }, line: { type: 'none' }
    });
    var stripTC = accentColor === 'A62BFF' ? 'FFFFFF' : '000000';
    slide.addText(statement, {
      x: 0.45, y: 0.3, w: 12.43, h: 2.0,
      fontFace: 'DM Serif Display', fontSize: 36, italic: true,
      color: stripTC, align: 'center', valign: 'middle', lineSpacingMultiple: 1.2
    });
    dotLine(slide, 0, 2.62, 13.33, 'CCCCCC');
    if (attribution) slide.addText(attribution, {
      x: 0.45, y: 3.0, w: 12.43, h: 3.5,
      fontFace: 'Montserrat', fontSize: 14,
      color: '333333', lineSpacingMultiple: 1.5
    });
    slide.addImage({ data: logoData(true), x: 11.45, y: 0.2, w: 1.65, h: 0.29 });
  }
}
```

### Accent Banner Row (inline highlight within a slide)

```js
function accentBanner(slide, text, accentColor, y, h) {

  });
}
```

## PptxGenJS Bootstrap

```js
const PptxGenJS = require('pptxgenjs');
const pptx = new PptxGenJS();
pptx.layout = 'LAYOUT_WIDE';

// All three accents are used in every deck — this is VélezReyes+ identity
const Y = 'F3FF00'; // Yellow — dark slides only (cover bar, closing bar, labels on black)
const G = '27CF77'; // Green  — cream slides (numbers, labels, card headers, arrows)
const P = 'A62BFF'; // Purple — cream slides (numbers, labels, section pills, split bg)

// Paste all helpers: logoData, accentBar, dotLine, dotLineV, dotRect,
// headerBar, addCover, addSection, addContent, addNumberedList,
// addTwoCol, addKPI, addStatement, accentBanner, addClosing

// Build slides:
const cover = pptx.addSlide();
addCover(cover, ACCENT, 'EYEBROW · DATE', 'Main Title', 'Subtitle Line', 'Italic tagline');

const s2 = pptx.addSlide();
addNumberedList(s2, 'Today we will cover', [
  { num: '01', title: 'Topic One:', body: 'Description here' },
  { num: '02', title: 'Topic Two:', body: 'Description here' },
], ACCENT);

// ... more slides

const closing = pptx.addSlide();
addClosing(closing, 'Thank You.', 'velezreyes.com', ACCENT);

pptx.writeFile({ fileName: 'output.pptx' }).then(() => console.log('Done'));
```

---

## Slide Type Library — Use Based on Content

Every deck is different. Choose slide types based on what the content actually needs, not a fixed order. The only fixed rules: Cover first, Closing last.

### Available slide types — pick freely

| Type | When to use |
|------|-------------|
| **Cover** | Always first |
| **Numbered list** | Agenda, steps, priorities, key topics |
| **Section divider** | Transitioning between major themes |
| **Content — text** | Narrative, explanation, context |
| **Two-column** | Comparisons, before/after, two concepts |
| **Three-column** | Three pillars, options, categories |
| **Cards grid** | 2–4 discrete items with equal weight |
| **KPI / Stats** | Key numbers, metrics, performance data |
| **Table** | Budget, structured data, comparisons with many variables |
| **Org chart** | Team structure, reporting lines, hierarchy |
| **Concept map** | Relationships, flows, processes, systems |
| **Mixed data** | Charts/graphs + quotes + stats on same slide |
| **Quote / Statement** | Key message, culture moment, bold claim |
| **Split bg** | High-contrast contrast between two ideas |
| **Full accent bg** | Highlight, culture, bold statement |
| **Top strip** | Statement header + supporting content below |
| **Banner rows** | Step-by-step with labeled sections, WHO/WHAT/HOW rows |
| **Closing** | Always last |

> Never follow a fixed sequence. Read the content and choose the type that serves it best.

## Additional Slide Templates

### Three-Column Content (cream)
```js
function addThreeCol(slide, title, cols, accentColors) {
  // cols = [{ label, title, body }] — array of 3
  // accentColors = [G, P, G] or similar — one per column
  slide.background = { color: 'EFEFE4' };
  hdr(slide, title, null);
  var cw = (12.43 - 0.6) / 3;
  cols.forEach(function(col, i) {
    var cx = 0.45 + i * (cw + 0.3);
    var ac = accentColors[i] || G;
    slide.addText(col.label ? col.label.toUpperCase() : '', {
      x:cx, y:1.08, w:cw, h:0.28,
      fontFace:'Montserrat', fontSize:9, bold:true, color:ac, charSpacing:1.5
    });
    slide.addText(col.title || '', {
      x:cx, y:1.4, w:cw, h:0.55,
      fontFace:'DM Serif Display', fontSize:22, color:'000000'
    });
    dotH(slide, cx, 2.0, cw, ac);
    slide.addText(col.body || '', {
      x:cx, y:2.12, w:cw, h:4.5,
      fontFace:'Montserrat', fontSize:13, color:'333333',
      valign:'top', lineSpacingMultiple:1.4
    });
    if (i < 2) dotV(slide, cx+cw+0.15, 1.0, 5.5, 'CCCCCC');
  });
}
```

### Table Slide (cream — budget, structured data)
Respects brand colors for header and subtotal/total rows.

```js
function addTable(slide, title, headers, rows) {
  // rows = [{ cells: [], type: 'normal'|'subtotal'|'total' }]
  slide.background = { color: 'EFEFE4' };
  hdr(slide, title, null);

  var tableRows = [];

  // Header row — black bg, white text
  tableRows.push(headers.map(function(h) {
    return {
      text: h,
      options: {
        bold: true, fontSize: 11, fontFace: 'Montserrat',
        color: 'FFFFFF', fill: { color: '000000' },
        align: 'center', valign: 'middle', margin: [0, 4, 0, 4]
      }
    };
  }));

  rows.forEach(function(row) {
    var isSubtotal = row.type === 'subtotal';
    var isTotal    = row.type === 'total';
    var fill = isTotal ? '27CF77' : isSubtotal ? 'A62BFF' : 'F3F1E7';
    var textColor = (isTotal || isSubtotal) ? 'FFFFFF' : '333333';
    if (isSubtotal) textColor = 'FFFFFF';
    tableRows.push(row.cells.map(function(cell, ci) {
      return {
        text: cell,
        options: {
          bold: isSubtotal || isTotal || ci === 0,
          fontSize: isTotal ? 12 : 11,
          fontFace: 'Montserrat',
          color: textColor,
          fill: { color: fill },
          align: ci === 0 ? 'left' : 'center',
          valign: 'middle',
          margin: [0, 4, 0, 4]
        }
      };
    }));
  });

  slide.addTable(tableRows, {
    x: 0.42, y: 1.05, w: 12.49,
    rowH: 0.38,
    border: { type: 'solid', color: 'DDDDCC', pt: 0.4 },
    autoPage: false
  });
}

// Usage:
// addTable(slide, 'Execution of 2025 Budget', 
//   ['Area','2025 Budget','Disbursed','Total Pipeline','Best Estimate','Forecast vs Best','%'],
//   [
//     { cells:['ECD','$969','$683','$90','$814','-$155','84%'], type:'normal' },
//     { cells:['Democracy','$3,401','$2,733','$75','$3,931','$530','116%'], type:'normal' },
//     { cells:['Subtotal Strategic','$9,178','$5,248','$202','$7,790','-$1,388','85%'], type:'subtotal' },
//     { cells:['TOTAL VER+ BUDGET','$19,002','$7,093','$247','$13,533','','71%'], type:'total' },
//   ]
// );
```

### Org Chart Slide (cream)
Hierarchical structure using rounded boxes + dotted connectors.

```js
function addOrgChart(slide, title, nodes) {
  // nodes = [{ id, label, sublabel, type:'current'|'new'|'pending'|'external', x, y, w, h, parentId }]
  // type colors: current=P (purple), new=Y (yellow, on dark box), pending=G (green), external='555555'
  slide.background = { color: 'EFEFE4' };
  hdr(slide, title, null);

  var typeColors = { current: P, new: 'F3FF00', pending: G, external: '555555' };
  var typeText   = { current: 'FFFFFF', new: '000000', pending: '000000', external: 'FFFFFF' };

  // Draw connector lines first (dotted)
  nodes.forEach(function(node) {
    if (!node.parentId) return;
    var parent = nodes.find(function(n){ return n.id === node.parentId; });
    if (!parent) return;
    var px = parent.x + parent.w / 2;
    var py = parent.y + parent.h;
    var cx = node.x + node.w / 2;
    var cy = node.y;
    var midY = (py + cy) / 2;
    // Vertical down from parent
    dotV(slide, px, py, midY - py, '999990');
    // Horizontal to child
    if (Math.abs(px - cx) > 0.05) {
      dotH(slide, Math.min(px,cx), midY, Math.abs(px-cx), '999990');
    }
    // Vertical down to child
    dotV(slide, cx, midY, cy - midY, '999990');
  });

  // Draw boxes
  nodes.forEach(function(node) {
    var bg = typeColors[node.type] || 'A62BFF';
    var tc = typeText[node.type] || 'FFFFFF';
    slide.addShape(pptx.ShapeType.roundRect, {
      x:node.x, y:node.y, w:node.w, h:node.h,
      fill:{ color: bg }, line:{ type:'none' }, rectRadius:0.06
    });
    slide.addText(node.label, {
      x:node.x+0.05, y:node.y, w:node.w-0.1, h:node.sublabel ? node.h*0.55 : node.h,
      fontFace:'Montserrat', fontSize:10, bold:true,
      color:tc, align:'center', valign: node.sublabel ? 'bottom' : 'middle'
    });
    if (node.sublabel) slide.addText('('+node.sublabel+')', {
      x:node.x+0.05, y:node.y+node.h*0.52, w:node.w-0.1, h:node.h*0.42,
      fontFace:'Montserrat', fontSize:9, color:tc,
      align:'center', valign:'top'
    });
  });

  // Legend
  var legendItems = [
    { label:'New hirings (for approval)', color:'F3FF00', tc:'000000' },
    { label:'Pending hirings (approved)', color:G, tc:'000000' },
    { label:'Current team', color:P, tc:'FFFFFF' },
  ];
  legendItems.forEach(function(l, i) {
    var lx = 2.5 + i * 3.5;
    slide.addShape(pptx.ShapeType.ellipse, {
      x:lx, y:1.12, w:0.22, h:0.22,
      fill:{color:l.color}, line:{type:'none'}
    });
    slide.addText(l.label, {
      x:lx+0.28, y:1.1, w:3.0, h:0.28,
      fontFace:'Montserrat', fontSize:10, color:'333333'
    });
  });
}
```

### Concept Map / Process Flow (cream)
Nodes connected by dotted arrows. All lines punteadas.

```js
function addConceptMap(slide, title, nodes, connections) {
  // nodes = [{ id, label, sublabel, x, y, w, h, accent }]
  // connections = [{ from, to, label, style:'solid-arrow'|'dotted' }]
  // accent: G=green, P=purple, 'EFEFE4'=neutral, '000000'=black
  slide.background = { color: 'EFEFE4' };
  hdr(slide, title, null);

  // Draw connections first
  connections.forEach(function(conn) {
    var from = nodes.find(function(n){ return n.id === conn.from; });
    var to   = nodes.find(function(n){ return n.id === conn.to; });
    if (!from || !to) return;
    var x1 = from.x + from.w, y1 = from.y + from.h/2;
    var x2 = to.x,            y2 = to.y   + to.h/2;
    dotH(slide, x1, y1, x2-x1, '999990');
    if (conn.label) slide.addText(conn.label, {
      x: x1 + (x2-x1)/2 - 0.5, y: y1 - 0.25, w: 1.0, h: 0.22,
      fontFace:'Montserrat', fontSize:8, color:'999990', align:'center'
    });
  });

  // Draw nodes
  nodes.forEach(function(node) {
    var ac = node.accent || P;
    var isDark = ac !== 'EFEFE4' && ac !== 'F3F1E7';
    var tc = isDark ? 'FFFFFF' : '000000';
    if (ac === G || ac === 'F3FF00') tc = '000000';
    slide.addShape(pptx.ShapeType.roundRect, {
      x:node.x, y:node.y, w:node.w, h:node.h,
      fill:{color: ac},
      line:{color: isDark ? ac : 'CCCCCC', width:0.6, dashType: isDark ? 'solid' : 'dot'},
      rectRadius:0.06
    });
    slide.addText(node.label, {
      x:node.x+0.1, y:node.y, w:node.w-0.2, h:node.sublabel ? node.h*0.55 : node.h,
      fontFace:'Montserrat', fontSize:11, bold:true,
      color:tc, align:'center', valign: node.sublabel ? 'bottom' : 'middle'
    });
    if (node.sublabel) slide.addText(node.sublabel, {
      x:node.x+0.1, y:node.y+node.h*0.52, w:node.w-0.2, h:node.h*0.4,
      fontFace:'Montserrat', fontSize:9, color:tc,
      align:'center', valign:'top'
    });
  });
}
```

### Mixed Data Slide (chart + quotes + stats)
For slides combining quantitative data with qualitative evidence — like the Attitudes/Knowledge reference.

```js
function addMixedData(slide, sectionLabel, chartPlaceholder, stat, statLabel, quote, insight) {
  // Left: chart area (placeholder — charts added manually or via image)
  // Right: stat + quote + insight
  slide.background = { color: 'EFEFE4' };
  hdr(slide, sectionLabel, null);

  // Left — chart area (leave open for manual chart/image insertion)
  // Comment in code marks the zone
  dotRect(slide, 0.42, 1.05, 5.8, 6.1, 'F3F1E7', 'CCCCCC');
  slide.addText('CHART', {
    x:0.42, y:3.5, w:5.8, h:0.5,
    fontFace:'Montserrat', fontSize:9, color:'BBBBAA',
    align:'center', bold:true, charSpacing:2
  });
  // Chart placeholder label
  if (chartPlaceholder) slide.addText(chartPlaceholder, {
    x:0.52, y:1.15, w:5.6, h:0.3,
    fontFace:'Montserrat', fontSize:9, color:'999990', align:'center'
  });

  // Dotted vertical divider
  dotV(slide, 6.42, 1.05, 6.1, 'CCCCCC');

  // Right — stat callout
  if (stat) {
    slide.addText(stat, {
      x:6.6, y:1.1, w:1.5, h:0.7,
      fontFace:'DM Serif Display', fontSize:40, color:P, align:'left'
    });
    if (statLabel) slide.addText(statLabel, {
      x:8.15, y:1.2, w:4.7, h:0.55,
      fontFace:'Montserrat', fontSize:13, bold:false, color:'000000',
      lineSpacingMultiple:1.3
    });
  }

  dotH(slide, 6.6, 1.95, 6.3, 'CCCCCC');

  // Green arrow + quote
  slide.addShape(pptx.ShapeType.ellipse, {
    x:6.6, y:2.12, w:0.38, h:0.38,
    fill:{color:G}, line:{type:'none'}
  });
  slide.addText('\u2192', {
    x:6.6, y:2.12, w:0.38, h:0.38,
    fontFace:'Montserrat', fontSize:14, bold:true,
    color:'000000', align:'center', valign:'middle'
  });
  if (quote) slide.addText('\u201c'+quote+'\u201d', {
    x:7.1, y:2.08, w:5.8, h:2.0,
    fontFace:'DM Serif Display', fontSize:14, italic:true,
    color:'333333', lineSpacingMultiple:1.4
  });

  dotH(slide, 6.6, 4.28, 6.3, 'CCCCCC');

  if (insight) slide.addText(insight, {
    x:6.6, y:4.42, w:6.3, h:2.5,
    fontFace:'Montserrat', fontSize:13, color:'333333',
    lineSpacingMultiple:1.4, valign:'top'
  });
}
```

---

## Content-First Decision Guide

Before choosing a slide type, ask: **what is this content trying to do?**

| Content goal | Best slide type |
|-------------|----------------|
| Introduce the deck | Cover |
| Show what we'll cover | Numbered list |
| Explain or narrate | Content — text or top strip |
| Compare two things | Two-column |
| Show three equal options/pillars | Three-column |
| Highlight 2–4 discrete items | Cards grid |
| Show key numbers | KPI / Stats |
| Show structured multi-variable data | Table |
| Show team structure | Org chart |
| Show a process or relationships | Concept map |
| Combine data + evidence + quotes | Mixed data |
| Make a bold statement | Quote / Statement or full accent bg |
| Create a visual contrast | Split background |
| Transition between sections | Section divider |
| Label steps with context | Banner rows |
| End the deck | Closing |

> Multiple content types on the same slide? Use the **mixed data** template or combine elements from different templates — VélezReyes+ decks often mix a chart area with a stat callout and a quote on the same slide, as seen in reference slides.

---

## Layout Principles

### Rounded corners — always
- **All containers use `roundRect`** — cards, quote boxes, KPI cells, banner rows, org nodes, concept map nodes, table-like boxes, accent callout blocks. `rectRadius: 0.06` is the standard. Use `0.28` for pill shapes (section numbers).
- **Only structural full-bleed shapes use `rect`** — the left accent bar (edge-to-edge height), the header bar (edge-to-edge width), split-bg halves, and top-strip blocks. These are architectural, not containers.
- Never use a sharp-cornered `rect` for any element that sits inside the slide content area.

```js
// ✓ Correct — container
slide.addShape(pptx.ShapeType.roundRect, { ..., rectRadius: 0.06 });

// ✓ Correct — pill
slide.addShape(pptx.ShapeType.roundRect, { ..., rectRadius: 0.28 });

// ✓ Correct — structural full-bleed (header bar, accent bar, split bg)
slide.addShape(pptx.ShapeType.rect, { x:0, y:0, w:13.33, h:0.82, ... });

// ✗ Wrong — sharp container inside slide content
slide.addShape(pptx.ShapeType.rect, { x:0.5, y:1.5, w:4.0, h:2.0, ... });
```

### Structure
1. **Cream is the base** — most content on `#EFEFE4`. Black and accent slides create rhythm and emphasis
2. **All lines are dotted** — separators, column dividers, KPI dividers, card borders, org chart connectors, concept map connectors. Only exception: the left solid accent bar on covers/closing
3. **DM Serif Display for display moments** — titles, section names, stats, quotes, org chart not needed
4. **Montserrat for everything operational** — headers, labels, body, captions, table content
5. **Logo always present** — top-right on content slides; centered special position on cover/closing
6. **No asset placeholders shown** — leave physical space open, mark in code with a comment

### Design quality (from base skill — always apply)
7. **Every slide needs a visual element** beyond text — a stat callout, a dotted card container, an accent color block, a chart zone, or a shape. Text-only slides are forgettable
8. **Size contrast is mandatory** — titles must visually dominate body text. Min ratio: title 2× body size. DM Serif at 26pt+ vs Montserrat at 13pt is the baseline
9. **Never repeat the same layout** on consecutive slides — vary between list, two-col, three-col, KPI, table, statement, org chart, concept map
10. **Left-align body text always** — only slide titles, KPI numbers, closing statements, and cover text are centered
11. **Consistent spacing** — 0.3" or 0.5" between content blocks; pick one and apply across all slides in the deck
12. **Breathe** — don't fill every inch. VélezReyes+ aesthetic values negative space
13. **Max 40 words on screen** — rest goes to speaker notes. Exception: tables and org charts where density is inherent
14. **NEVER use accent underlines under titles** — that's AI slop. Use header bars, dotted separators, and color blocks instead

### Color application on slides
15. **Yellow only on dark** — `#F3FF00` as text/number/label only on `#000000` or `#1A1A1A` backgrounds
16. **Green + Purple freely on cream** — numbers, labels, card headers, stat callouts, arrows
17. **All three must appear** — every deck uses Y + G + P somewhere
18. **Accent backgrounds sparingly** — full accent bg max 1–2 slides per deck; split bg is a strong moment

### Tables
19. **Header row**: black bg `#000000`, white text, Montserrat Bold 11pt
20. **Normal rows**: alternating `#F3F1E7` / `#E8E8DC`, dark text `#333333`
21. **Subtotal rows**: Purple `#A62BFF` bg, white text, bold
22. **Total rows**: Green `#27CF77` bg, black text, bold
23. **Borders**: dotted `#DDDDCC` 0.4pt

### Org charts + concept maps
24. **All connector lines**: dotted, color `#999990`
25. **Node types**: current team = Purple, new hiring = Yellow (on dark node bg), pending = Green, external = `#555555`
26. **Node shape**: `roundRect` always
27. **Legend required** on org chart slides

---

## Rules — Never Break

- **NEVER use yellow `#F3FF00` on cream backgrounds** — it is invisible. Yellow only on black/dark slides or as background fill (never as text on cream)
- **All containers use `roundRect` with `rectRadius: 0.06`** — cards, quote boxes, org nodes, concept map nodes, KPI cells, banners, callout blocks. Sharp `rect` only for full-bleed structural shapes (header bar, accent bar, split-bg halves, top strip)
- All structural lines must use `dashType: 'dot'` — no solid separator lines except the left accent bar
- Never use white `#FFFFFF` as slide background
- Never put dark text directly on black — use white or cream
- Never use black text on purple — use white
- Never use white text on yellow or green — use black
- **All three accents must appear in every deck** — this is VélezReyes+ identity. Yellow on dark slides only. Green + Purple freely on cream slides.
- Always include logo on every slide
- Always include closing slide
- Always use DM Serif Display for titles, section names, stats, and statements
- Never repeat same layout on consecutive slides
- Never show a visual placeholder for asset space — leave it open, note in code comments
